concerns.text: Constitution Principle VI requires raw magnetic‑property data to be obtained **exclusively from the Materials Project REST API**, but the task downloads a bulk archive snapshot from Zenodo. This violates FR‑030 VI.
Success Criterion SC‑006 (pipeline wall‑clock ≤ 6 hours) is listed in the spec but no task includes a verification step that asserts this runtime bound, so the acceptance criterion is omitted.

The spec’s acceptance scenario expects a cleaned dataset saved as `data.csv`, yet the task creates `data/cleaned_alloys.csv`. This naming mismatch breaks traceability to the spec and may cause the acceptance test to fail.
